note: Sources of the 4 initial question/reference-answer rows (D0) per domain used by the formal EvoKD-Adapted runs. Only source identifiers, construction rules and sha256 of the formal texts are recorded; the formal texts are not distributed. Build your own D0 with tools/build_evokd_d0.py; the sha256 values tell whether a rebuilt row equals the formal one.

medicine.rows_are: rows 0, 10, 20, 30 of the 40 Medicine cold-start rows (Seed40), i.e. the first row of each source dataset in that file's order (see manifests/medicine_seed40_sources.json)
medicine.question_note: The question of every row is a hand-written rewrite of the source item (no model); write it yourself from the source item following the rule in 'origin'. tools/build_evokd_d0.py reports whether your text equals the formal one (sha256); a different wording is a valid, different D0. The reference answer is taken from the source dataset, so it needs no Teacher call.
